# Radisson Blu Resort Fujairah

> Radisson Blu Resort Fujairah, opened originally under the Radisson SAS brand, is a beachfront resort on the Al Aqah coast of Fujairah, set between the Hajar Mountains and the Gulf of Oman. It has 257 rooms and suites, all with sea views, alongside restaurants, swimming pools, a spa and a private beach. Snoopy Island, one of the country's best-known snorkelling and diving spots, lies just offshore.

## Project Overview

- Category: Hospitality & Landmark Entertainment
- Location: Al Aqah, Fujairah, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Radisson Blu Resort Fujairah, originally branded Radisson SAS, is a beachfront resort on the Al Aqah coast of Fujairah overlooking the Indian Ocean, with 257 rooms and suites. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the resort as subcontractor to East Coast Contracting, with Shadid Engineering Consultants as consultant. The project reflects MENASCO's hospitality expertise on the UAE's east coast.
